focus_area_title: Finding Success Starts with Finding Your Purpose
content_text_body:
Success without significance - purpose, service, and meaningful relationships - is not really success at all. It's important to properly reflect on how we can live a meaningful life not just with the superficial trappings of "success" but with deep purpose and joy in all we do. 

Ask yourself:  What is the core purpose of my work and the ways in which it makes the world better? Who are the key relationships in my life, and how can I deepen them? What more can I do at work, at home, and in my community to serve others? How am I becoming better each day? Read [this article](<HBR_Finding_Success_Starts_with_Finding_Your_Purpose>) to learn more.
